marketing.announcement: Own the agent. Control the answers. Prove what happened.
marketing.heroHeading: AI agents your business actually owns.
marketing.heroSubtitle: Launch a customer support agent in minutes, control what it knows, review what it does, and prove every interaction without a developer or a black box.
marketing.heroImageAlt: MindRithm dashboard showing owned AI agents and operating controls
marketing.feature1Description: Customer questions, knowledge, conversation history, and launch settings stay under your control.
marketing.feature2Description: Build the agent with your knowledge, policies, channels, and escalation rules without waiting on engineering.
marketing.feature3Description: Audit trails and review gates make each answer easier to trust, explain, and improve.
marketing.problemTitle: You do not need more AI hype. You need control.
marketing.problemSubtitle: Generic bots are easy to try and hard to trust. Internal builds take months. Meanwhile, your customers still need fast, accurate answers.
marketing.problemExternalTitle: AI tools do not fit your business
marketing.problemExternalDesc: They miss your policies, products, tone, and escalation rules.
marketing.problemInternalDesc: No one wants a bot answering customers with data they cannot verify or undo.
marketing.problemPhilosophicalTitle: Using AI should not mean giving up ownership
marketing.problemPhilosophicalDesc: Your business should control the agent, knowledge, and proof trail.
marketing.featuresTitle: Build one owned support agent, then expand the workflow
marketing.featuresSubtitle: Start with support for Shopify or your website. Add knowledge, actions, review gates, and channels on the same platform as you grow.
marketing.featureBuilderDesc: Add product docs, FAQs, pricing, policies, and source types so answers come from facts you control.
marketing.featureReviewDesc: Use test chat, audit history, and human review gates before an agent reaches customers.
marketing.featurePublishDesc: Define when the agent should answer, ask for more information, or hand the conversation to a person.
marketing.featureWhiteLabelDesc: Test updates with a smaller audience, pause agents, and roll back when a new version needs more work.
marketing.featureRegulatedDesc: Go self-serve with a Shopify or website agent, or use MindRithm Launch for a fixed-scope production workflow.
marketing.proofTitle: Go from AI idea to owned agent in three steps
marketing.proofSubtitle: You do not need a 12-month platform project to start safely.
marketing.proofGovernDesc: Start with support, ecommerce, onboarding, or a custom workflow.
marketing.proofTestDesc: Connect the facts, boundaries, source types, and escalation paths your agent should follow.
marketing.proofPublishDesc: Use test chat, audit history, and rollout controls before customers see the agent.
marketing.screenshotsSubtitle: The builder, dashboard, and test chat keep ownership controls close to the work, not buried in a policy document.
